alex_chung: Heads up — ACME checkout is returning a spike of card declines this morning. Customer says multiple users hit "3DS failed" and some show 'insufficient_funds' in UI. Our logs show a bunch of gateway timeouts around 08:12 UTC. sample_charge: ch_1Gz9x... gateway_request_id: gw_8a7c.
maria_k: Thanks — are these all the same card network/acquirer or spread across issuers?
alex_chung: Mostly Visa and Mastercard, different issuers. Decline pattern looks like: successful auth -> 3DS redirect started -> no callback -> gateway times out -> we mark as declined. Count is ~24 failures in last 10m (normal ~1). Screenshots from customer attached in ticket.
jamal_r: @maria_k @alex_chung can you paste the raw gateway response for one of the failing requests? I want the http status + body. Also which timeout do we use for 3DS (frontend->gateway) today? Might be too short for some acquirers.
alex_chung: Raw snippet:
```
POST /charge
Status: 504 Gateway Timeout
Body: {"error":"3d_secure_timeout","request_id":"gw_8a7c","message":"3DS callback not received from ACS"}
```
jamal_r: OK that looks like the ACS (issuer's 3DS page) is slow or blocking. Our current 3DS callback timeout is 10s (payments-config: `three_ds.callback_timeout_ms=10000`). Some issuers take up to 20-30s. Two options: increase timeout for callback, or implement a graceful retry/fallback so we don't map 504 -> hard decline immediately.
ian_support: Customer-facing note: advise users to try an alternate card or retry after 30s. Also ask them to try from a different network (some banks block embedded browsers). I'll send a scripted reply.
elaine_ops: If we raise callback to 30s we need to check concurrency/batch backpressure on the runtime. Quick check: current concurrent 3DS waits ~350 sessions on payments-host. If we increase, we might need to bump pool size or enable eviction for long-pollers.
jamal_r: Repro steps for eng: simulate slow ACS by adding delay to the 3ds-return endpoint. Example repro curl to emulate ACS hang:
```
# hit our charge endpoint with test card that triggers 3DS
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/charges \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" \
  -d '{"amount":1000,"card":"pm_test_3ds","return_url":"https://3ds-test/slow?delay=25"}'
```
Expected gateway response when ACS delays > timeout:
```
HTTP/1.1 504
{"error":"3d_secure_timeout","request_id":"gw_xxxx"}
```
If you want to repro locally, set `three_ds.callback_timeout_ms=5000` and hit the above with delay=8s.
payments_bot: Ticket created: PAY-7821 — "ACME high rate of 3DS timeouts -> declines". Assigned to @jamal_r. SLA: 4h response. https://tickets.internal/PAY-7821
maria_k: Customer asked whether these were 'insufficient funds' or fraud. UI shows 'insufficient_funds' in some cases because when we get no callback we surface a generic decline code; but gateway body shows `3d_secure_timeout`. Need to fix mapping so customers get clearer message.
jamal_r: Action items:
1) Short term: update mapping so 3d_secure_timeout surfaces to support messages and not map to insufficient_funds.
2) Mid term: raise three_ds.callback_timeout_ms to 30000 for prod and increase payments pool by +20% (ops to vet).
3) Add retry policy: on `3d_secure_timeout` do 1 delayed retry after 30s if gateway supports reattempt, otherwise mark as pending and notify merchant.
elaine_ops: I can open a rollout PR to bump timeout and scale. Need an approval from infra — pinging infra channel.
ian_support: I'll update ACME reply with workaround and explain it's a 3DS timing issue, not a fraud block. Also asked for a list of affected user ids.
alex_chung: Adding example logs to the ticket (pasted). Observed `acquirer_response_code` is null for the timeouts. Where should we store the mapping change PR? payments-service repo?
jamal_r: Yes payments-service. I'll create a small patch: change mapping + feature flag `three_ds_timeout_improved_mapping` so we can roll back. Also will add a metric for `% declines due to 3d_secure_timeout`.
maria_k: Thanks — keeps us from contacting acquirers yet. If after 2h the rate doesn't drop, we should loop in the gateway provider (Stripe/Adyen) and merchant acquirer.
payments_bot: Update on PAY-7821: initial triage done, assigned to eng@payments, priority P2. Next update scheduled 08:50 UTC.
elaine_ops: Quick command to check current config in prod:
```
kubectl get configmap payments-config -n prod -o yaml | grep three_ds.callback_timeout_ms
```
jamal_r: I'll pick this up, make the mapping PR, and prepare the timeout increase behind a feature flag. If anyone sees >5% decline rate from 3DS timeouts, escalate to payments oncall immediately.
ian_support: Customer update sent (w/ workaround). I'll paste the thread in the ticket.
alex_chung: Thanks team — keeping this thread open until we see decline rate normalize. :thumbsup:
